A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DeltaFlow research and contain 18 readable pages, including Appendices A–C. Text, equations, tables, and rendered figures support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original DeltaFlow evaluations on Argoverse 2, Waymo, and nuScenes, together with ablations, runtime measurements, cross-domain tests, and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in the main text and Appendix B, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and cross-domain evaluations.

M1.justification: The temporal delta scheme, sparse representation, backbone-decoder architecture, and three loss components are unchanged. Section 3 and Appendix A.1 retain the same equations and algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use Argoverse 2, Waymo, and nuScenes, with identical multi-frame scenarios, cross-domain transfers, and qualitative example scenes in the appendices.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding benchmark, transfer, and ablation experiments. SSF remains the same evaluated baseline despite its updated publication citation.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A.2 retain the same splits, annotation processing, nuScenes sampling frequency, metrics, frame counts, voxel settings, and training budgets.

E4.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain the same scalability, temporal-decay, loss-component, cross-domain, feature-visualization, and qualitative error analyses. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests for the experimental results.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout, including Appendix B. For example, Table 1 retains five-frame DeltaFlow's mean bucket-normalized error of 0.113 and three-way EPE of 2.11 cm.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, loss formulations, sparse delta algorithm, and Appendix B.1 complexity analysis are unchanged. No mathematical correction, new assumption, or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about efficient multi-frame estimation, the two proposed losses, accuracy, scalability, and cross-domain generalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations of temporal context and loss tradeoffs remain identical. The supervised-label limitation, proposed future directions, and Appendix C discussion of benefits and privacy risks are also retained.

D1.justification: Implementation instructions, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, augmentation details, and code/model-weight disclosures are unchanged. The local PDFs contain identical code-access links.

R1.justification: The same distinct cited works and substantive research positioning remain. The bibliography consolidates duplicate SMORE, DifFlow3D, and EmerNeRF entries and updates SSF and HiMo publication metadata; these are bibliographic edits.

P1.justification: Edits concern citation consolidation and renumbering, publication metadata, HiMo author-name ordering, and the arXiv version/date stamp. Main-text and appendix wording and section organization otherwise match.

P2.justification: Bibliography cleanup reflows reference entries across pages 11–13. All 11 figures and nine tables retain their content, structure, and placement; caption changes are limited to citation numbers.

improvement.justification: v3 provides a small editorial improvement by removing three duplicate bibliography entries and updating SSF/HiMo publication details, including HiMo's author-name ordering. This improves bibliographic consistency and precision, while the scientific content, empirical support, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
